projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
End-to-end analytics dashboard that (1) ingests and processes customer CSV files, (2) analyzes application logs, and (3) presents insights through reusable visualization components. Scope covers data contracts, ingestion, validation/cleaning, log parsing and metrics, visualization library, API integration, QA, security (PII handling), and launch readiness. Work is organized under six milestones with every deliverable sized at complexity <= 5 so it can be executed by a single owner in a short iteration.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-engineering, visualization, logs

tasks.name: Milestone 1: Foundation & Architecture
tasks.details: Establish the technical foundation before feature work: data contracts for all sources, architecture decision, repository/CI setup, and the storage layer that both CSV and log pipelines will write to. Exit criteria: signed-off data contracts, architecture doc, running CI, and provisioned storage with schemas.

tasks.name: Milestone 2: Customer CSV Data Processing
tasks.details: Build the customer CSV ingestion and processing pipeline: upload/read, schema validation, cleaning, deduplication, error quarantine, and loading into the warehouse. Exit criteria: a customer CSV can be processed end-to-end with a data quality report, and pipeline tests pass.

tasks.name: Milestone 3: Application Log Analysis
tasks.details: Turn raw application logs into queryable metrics: parsing, normalization/enrichment, aggregation, anomaly detection and retention. Exit criteria: error-rate and latency metrics are computed from real log samples, anomaly rules fire correctly in tests, and retention/indexing is documented.

tasks.name: Milestone 4: Visualization Components
tasks.details: Create the reusable visualization layer: design tokens and component library, chart primitives with data adapters, dashboard layout and filtering, drill-down interaction, accessibility/responsiveness, and documentation. Exit criteria: charts render against live/sample metrics, pass accessibility checks, and are catalogued in Storybook.

tasks.name: Milestone 5: API & Frontend Integration
tasks.details: Expose processed CSV and log metrics through stable APIs and wire them into the visualization layer, including caching and query performance tuning. Exit criteria: dashboard views load real data within agreed performance budget, with contract tests between API and UI.

tasks.name: Milestone 6: QA, Security & Launch
tasks.details: Harden and ship: end-to-end testing, PII/security review of CSV and log data, deployment pipeline with observability, and documentation/handover. Exit criteria: E2E green, security sign-off on PII handling, production deploy with dashboards and alerts, and a handover guide.

tasks.name: Define data contracts & schemas for CSV and log sources
tasks.details: Document the field-level contract for customer CSV files (column names, types, required/optional, PII flags, expected volumes) and for application log records (timestamp, level, service, message, request_id, latency fields). Produce versioned schema files (e.g. JSON Schema / dbt sources) agreed with data owners. Acceptance: schemas committed, sample files validate against them, PII fields flagged.

tasks.name: Select tech stack & write architecture decision record
tasks.details: Choose and justify: processing engine (e.g. Python/pandas vs SQL/dbt), warehouse (Postgres vs DuckDB vs cloud warehouse), API framework, and frontend charting library. Capture alternatives considered, cost/latency trade-offs and reversibility in an ADR. Acceptance: ADR reviewed and merged; no open questions blocking storage or pipeline work.

tasks.name: Set up repository, dev environment & CI pipeline skeleton
tasks.details: Create monorepo layout (ingestion/, analysis/, api/, web/), README, linting/formatting, pre-commit hooks, docker-compose for local services, and a CI workflow running lint + unit tests on PR. Acceptance: fresh clone runs tests locally and CI passes on an initial PR.

tasks.name: Provision analytics storage & apply base schemas
tasks.details: Stand up the dev/staging database or warehouse instance, create the raw/staging/marts schemas, apply the tables defined in the data contracts, and add migration tooling plus seed data. Acceptance: migrations run from scratch in CI, and a smoke query returns seeded rows.

tasks.name: Build CSV upload & ingestion entrypoint
tasks.details: Implement the entrypoint (CLI or upload endpoint) that accepts a customer CSV, checks encoding/delimiter/file size, assigns an ingestion batch ID, and lands the raw file in a landing zone. Acceptance: valid sample file ingested and recorded; oversize/wrong-encoding files rejected with a clear message.

tasks.name: Implement schema validation & type coercion
tasks.details: Validate incoming CSVs against the agreed schema: required columns, types, value ranges and referential codes. Produce row-level and file-level validation results with actionable messages; reject structurally invalid files and route bad rows to quarantine. Acceptance: unit tests cover missing column, bad type, out-of-range and valid cases.

tasks.name: Implement cleaning & normalization rules
tasks.details: Normalize dates to ISO-8601, trim/case-fold text fields, standardize nulls and country/currency codes, and cast numeric strings. Keep the transformations declarative and covered by table-driven tests with before/after fixtures. Acceptance: messy sample rows produce expected normalized output; rules documented alongside the schema.

tasks.name: Add dedupe & data quality report
tasks.details: Detect exact duplicates, route rejected rows to quarantine with reasons, and emit a per-batch quality report (rows in/valid/quarantined/duplicate/duration). Business-key dedupe is out of scope for this task and tracked separately if needed. Acceptance: report matches golden numbers in tests.

tasks.name: Load processed customer data into warehouse & add pipeline tests
tasks.details: Upsert cleaned rows into the customer staging/marts tables with idempotent batch semantics, then add integration tests that run the full pipeline against a fixture CSV and assert row counts and key field values. Acceptance: re-running the same batch produces no duplicates; integration test runs in CI.

tasks.name: Build log parser for JSON and plain-text formats
tasks.details: Parse both structured JSON log lines and unstructured plain-text lines into a common record shape (timestamp, level, service, message, request_id, status, latency). Handle multiline stack traces and malformed lines without crashing. Acceptance: parser test suite covers both formats plus malformed lines with >95% parse success on a real sample.

tasks.name: Normalize & enrich log records
tasks.details: Map severity aliases to a canonical level, derive service and environment from metadata, extract HTTP status class and endpoint templates, and attach ingestion timestamp. Acceptance: enrichment rules unit-tested; enriched sample rows match expected canonical fields.

tasks.name: Implement log aggregation jobs
tasks.details: Build scheduled aggregations per service and 5-minute bucket for request volume and error rate. Latency percentiles (p95/p99) are delivered in a separate follow-up task to keep this increment small. Acceptance: output verified against a hand-computed fixture for two buckets.

tasks.name: Define anomaly detection rules & alert routing
tasks.details: Specify threshold and simple baseline rules (error rate spike, latency regression, log volume drop) with configurable windows, plus routing to the dashboard alert feed. Acceptance: rule unit tests prove fire/no-fire behavior on synthetic series; alert payload schema documented.

tasks.name: Define log indexing, retention & sampling policy
tasks.details: Decide partitioning/indexes for query performance, retention windows per tier (hot/warm), and sampling for high-volume debug logs. Document storage cost implications and apply partition config to metric/raw log tables. Acceptance: policy doc merged and partitions/indexes applied in staging.

tasks.name: Set up component library, design tokens & Storybook
tasks.details: Create the web package with the chosen framework, design tokens (color, spacing, typography, chart palette), base layout primitives, and Storybook running locally and in CI. Acceptance: Storybook builds and deploys a preview per PR.

tasks.name: Build chart primitives with data adapters
tasks.details: Implement line, bar, donut, KPI tile and data-table components behind a shared props contract, plus adapters mapping API payloads to chart series. Acceptance: each primitive has stories for populated, sparse and single-point data; adapter unit tests pass.

tasks.name: Build dashboard layout & filters
tasks.details: Compose the analytics grid and add global date-range and service filters stored in URL state. Cross-filter linking between widgets is a separate follow-up task. Acceptance: filters update dependent widgets and are deep-linkable via URL.

tasks.name: Add drill-down, tooltips & loading/empty/error states
tasks.details: Implement tooltip formatting, click-through drill-down from aggregate to detail view, and explicit loading skeleton, empty and error states for every widget. Acceptance: each state demonstrated in Storybook and covered by component tests.

tasks.name: Add accessibility & responsive behavior
tasks.details: Keyboard navigation for interactive charts, screen-reader summaries/table fallbacks, color-contrast-safe palette, and responsive layouts for laptop and tablet widths. Acceptance: automated axe checks pass with no critical issues; manual keyboard pass recorded.

tasks.name: Write component docs & visual regression tests
tasks.details: Document props, data contracts and usage guidance per component in Storybook; add screenshot-based visual regression tests for the chart primitives. Acceptance: docs published to the Storybook site and visual tests run in CI.

tasks.name: Design & implement metrics API endpoints
tasks.details: Expose read endpoints for customer aggregates, log error rate, request volume and latency series with filter parameters (date range, service, segment). Use consistent envelope, error codes and pagination. Acceptance: endpoints return correct data for seeded fixtures within 500ms locally.

tasks.name: Add API contract tests & OpenAPI documentation
tasks.details: Publish an OpenAPI spec for the metrics endpoints, generate request/response validation in tests, and add contract tests that fail on breaking schema changes. Acceptance: spec published, contract tests green in CI.

tasks.name: Wire dashboard views to APIs & handle errors
tasks.details: Replace fixture data with live API calls using a shared query layer, add request de-duplication, retries and user-facing error toasts, and keep filters synchronized with requests. Acceptance: all dashboard widgets load from the API with no console errors.

tasks.name: Add caching, pagination & query performance tuning
tasks.details: Add response caching with sensible TTLs, cursor pagination for detail tables, and index/query tuning for the slowest metric queries based on a measured profile. Acceptance: p95 dashboard load under the agreed budget on staging data volume.

tasks.name: Build end-to-end test suite for critical journeys
tasks.details: Automate the critical paths: upload a CSV and see updated customer widgets, view log error-rate and latency charts, apply filters and drill down. Run against a seeded staging environment in CI. Acceptance: 3-5 stable E2E scenarios green on two consecutive runs.

tasks.name: Complete PII & security review for CSV and log data
tasks.details: Review where customer PII lands: mask/redact direct identifiers in logs, verify encryption at rest/in transit, restrict dashboard access by role, and check secrets handling and retention alignment. Produce a security checklist with sign-off. Acceptance: no unmasked PII in analytics/log tables; checklist approved by security owner.

tasks.name: Set up deployment pipeline, monitoring & alerting
tasks.details: Add build/deploy stages for api and web, environment configuration, DB migration step, health checks, structured logging, uptime and error-rate alerts. Acceptance: one-click deploy to staging and a documented rollback; alert fires on a simulated failure.

tasks.name: Write user guide, runbook & handover session
tasks.details: Document how to upload CSVs, interpret each dashboard panel, respond to alerts, and troubleshoot failed batches. Include a data dictionary and an on-call runbook. Acceptance: docs reviewed by a non-author who completes the walkthrough unaided.

tasks.name: Add business-key dedupe rules
tasks.details: Match duplicates on customer_id plus normalized email hash, keep the most recent record, and record superseded rows in a history table. Acceptance: unit tests cover match, no-match and keep-latest cases.

tasks.name: Add latency percentile calculations
tasks.details: Compute p95 and p99 latency per service and 5-minute bucket using warehouse percentile functions, written to the metrics table and verified against a hand-calculated fixture. Acceptance: results within 1ms of expected values.

tasks.name: Add cross-filter linking between widgets
tasks.details: Selecting a series or bar filters the other widgets on the page, with a visible active-filter chip and reset control, persisted in URL state. Acceptance: selection and reset behave correctly in component tests.
